name: Clos de Tart
rightsHistoryPurpose: Official filiation, dated legal-entity rights and original-reference evidence for Clos de Tart (#461). None establishes current farming.

reviewedUncoveredArea.note: The measured 323.908325 m² remainder (0.4318%) was reviewed against the pinned INAO boundary and Chambolle-Musigny and Morey-Saint-Denis cadastres. The remainder is a single narrow strip along the cru's northern edge, between the official line and the nearest cadastral parcels. It is 1 piece with a mean width of 1.25 m. All of it lies along the outline edge. It is not a missing INAO commune. 323.908325 m² is covered by no audited parcel. No geometry is added, clipped, buffered or filled. The absolute cap allows less than 0.1 m² above this reviewed measurement; changed source hashes require another review.

namedPlots.coverageNote: The official wine-board list names Clos de Tart as the cru's only climat. The pinned cadastre records CLOS DE TART over about 97% of the outline; the southern part lies in the cadastral LES BONNES MARES, which has no reviewed crosswalk. The whole-cru outline is retained; producer holdings are not shown.
